commercial-moving.why: Registry name is 'Commercial and Office Moving'.

commercial-relocation.why: Commercial relocation is the commercial moving service under its relocation name; warehouse relocation is its own registry service and is NOT this label.

custom-crating.why: Registry slug is the short form of Custom Crating.

ffe-installation.why: Installation is the FF&E service's core task.

flexible-deployment.why: Flexible deployment is the project-managed workforce model; its engagements are led by logistics project management.

freight-rework.why: Short form of the registry service name.

government-moving.why: Registry slug drops the -moving suffix (Government Moving).

industrial-rigging.why: Rigging as sold work sits in Industrial & Commercial Services; SIR Heavy is the protocol service for the 1,500-3,500 lb band and stays distinct.

ispm15-export-packing.why: Registry slug is the short form of ISPM 15 Export Packing.

loading.why: Registry transloading name is 'Loading, Transloading and Container Services' — loading is named in it.

medical-lab.why: Short form of the registry service name.

military-moving.why: Registry slug drops the -moving suffix (Military Moving).

ocean-container.why: Container services are named in the transloading registry service; per-port depth rides the ports datasets.

pods.why: Portable-container moves are sold inside moving & storage.

residential-moving.why: Registry slug shortens the service name (Residential Moving); geojson uses the full name form.

restacking.why: Restacking is a container/transloading task (also priced in the industrial CWT schedule; the coverage cell stays with transloading, its home family).

route-81.why: Registry slug drops the hyphen (Route 81 Corridor Moving and Dispatch).

transloading-winchester.why: Short form of the branch-specific registry service.

warehouse-distribution.why: Distribution support is 3PL work; warehouse RELOCATION is a different registry service and is not this label.

warehouse-racking.why: Short form of the registry service name.

coverage_math: 2,769 geojson cells, all resolved: 1,437 strict-slug direct + 422 name-form alias cells (6 labels found by the production builder 2026-11-09: residential-moving 74, government-moving 74, military-moving 74, custom-crating 69, ispm15-export-packing 69, route-81 62) + 910 cells under the original 14 labels (5 alias, 8 work-type, 1 program). Map now carries 20 labels (11 alias, 8 work-type, 1 program) onto the 34-service registry; every feature's coverage fully counted, labels preserved. The P1 prototype's 1,859 "direct" figure = 1,437 strict + 422 name-form; its name-normalization matcher is retired — one reconciliation mechanism (this map) only.
note: DRAFT for review — maps the geojson's 20 non-slug service labels onto the 34-service registry. Classes: alias = same service under another name; work-type = a task sold inside the parent service (coverage cell counts under the parent, label preserved in the cell); program = a delivery model spanning services (counts under the named lead service). No cell is dropped; every geojson label keeps its name in the coverage table.
